vaccine.hepb.name: Hepatitis B
vaccine.hepb.prevents: Prevents hepatitis B disease, which can cause liver damage and cancer.
vaccine.bcg.name: BCG
vaccine.bcg.prevents: Prevents pulmonary TB (tuberculosis) and serious complications such as bone TB and meningitis.
vaccine.polio.name: Polio
vaccine.polio.prevents: Prevents polio, a virus that attacks the brain and spinal cord and can cause leg paralysis.
vaccine.dpt.name: DPT
vaccine.dpt.prevents: Prevents diphtheria (nose and throat infection causing breathing difficulty), pertussis (whooping cough), and tetanus (jaw and neck muscle spasms).
vaccine.campak.name: Measles
vaccine.campak.prevents: Prevents measles (fever, red rash) and rubella (German measles), which can cause ear infection, pneumonia, seizures, brain damage, and death.
vaccine.hib.name: Hib
vaccine.hib.prevents: Prevents diseases caused by Hib bacteria such as meningitis, blood infection (sepsis), pneumonia, and epiglottitis.
vaccine.pcv.name: PCV
vaccine.pcv.prevents: Prevents diseases caused by pneumococcal infection, such as pneumonia, meningitis, and blood infection (sepsis).
vaccine.rotavirus.name: Rotavirus
vaccine.rotavirus.prevents: Prevents acute diarrhea (severe vomiting and watery stools).
vaccine.influenza.name: Influenza
vaccine.influenza.prevents: Prevents influenza virus infection (fever, cough, runny nose with muscle aches). Repeated every year.
vaccine.dengue.name: Dengue (DBV)
vaccine.je.name: Japanese Encephalitis (TBE)
vaccine.je.prevents: Prevents disease caused by the Japanese encephalitis virus, transmitted through mosquito bites, which can cause brain inflammation.
vaccine.tipoid.name: Typhoid
vaccine.tipoid.prevents: Prevents typhoid fever caused by Salmonella typhi bacterial infection. Repeated every 3 years.
vaccine.hepa.name: Hepatitis A
vaccine.hepa.prevents: Prevents hepatitis A (a highly contagious liver infection).
vaccine.varisela.name: Varicella
vaccine.varisela.prevents: Prevents chickenpox (fever with fluid-filled blisters all over the body that can leave permanent scars).
vaccine.mmr.name: MMR
vaccine.mmr.prevents: Prevents mumps (swelling of salivary glands below the ears, can cause brain inflammation, deafness, testicular/ovarian inflammation), measles, and rubella (German measles).
vaccine.td.name: Td
vaccine.td.prevents: Td vaccine (Tetanus diphtheria) to complete the previous DPT vaccine doses.
vaccine.hpv.name: HPV
vaccine.covid.name: Covid-19
